name: Eupithius of Athens
bio: Eupithius of Athens is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 3rd century AD (with a query).
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 206).

poems.title: Book IX, 206: On finishing the Punctuation and Accentuation of Herodian’s “Universal Prosody”
poems.author: Eupithius of Athens
poems.text: Ou for the number of rules all saying the same thing, and scarcely visible scratches, the work of my fine pen! My eyes ache, my wrist, my back, my neck and shoulders, and I feel universally the pain of the “Universal.”
